body: Wire --driver <local|remote-sdk> and --dry-run into agb run in bin/agb.mjs, and update commands/agb.md and skills/agb/SKILL.md. Register lib/remote-sdk-worker.mjs in scripts/release-audit-collect.mjs. Document AGB_REMOTE_SDK_BIN and AGB_LINUX_CONTAINER_ATTESTATION in website/env-docs.json, regenerate website/generated/*, verify node website/scripts/check-all.mjs, and rebuild dist/**. Verify: npm run build && node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check && node website/scripts/check-all.mjs && npm run skills:check
title: CLI Wiring (agb run --driver), Audit Registry, Website Docs & Bundles
